description: §8.10 Tier 2 loop hoisting (RUNTIME, sqlEngine:"real"): the loop body's single keyed `?{}` read sits NESTED — inside an `if`, an `else`, an `else if`, a nested `if`, an inner loop, and a `.all()` inside an `if`. The loop is rewritten to one pre-fetch + a per-iteration Map lookup and each read keeps its meaning: id 7 → the row, id 8 → `not` (no row), id 9 → the branch that does not read. Pre-S455 the planner hoisted these loops (its detector walks every depth) but the body rewrite recursed only through a node's `body` array, so the nested read was never replaced: the pre-fetch ran and the read itself was emitted with no server boundary — `null /* client cannot evaluate */` — so every row read `not` on success ("none,none,skip"), and `.all()` threw on `null.length`.
rationale: §8.10: "A for-loop whose body contains a single keyed `?{}` read SHALL be rewritten to a single `WHERE IN (...)` pre-fetch plus per-iteration `Map` lookup." §8.10.1 condition 2 ("Loop body contains exactly one `?{}` block") places no depth restriction. §8.10.2: `.get()` missing keys yield `not`; `.all()` yields a possibly-empty array. §8.10.3: "The rewritten loop is observationally equivalent to the un-rewritten loop".
